title: No distinction: all have sinned and need God's glory
english: There is no distinction: all have sinned and lack the glory of God. God's righteousness comes through faith of Jesus Christ to all who believe—not from works of the law, but freely through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus (Romans 3:22-24).
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Origen is quoting Paul's words from Romans 3 about the universal state of sin and the righteousness of God given through faith in Jesus Christ.

title: Christ set forth as atoning sacrifice through faith
english: God set him forth as an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for the showing of his righteousness, so that he himself might be righteous and the one who justifies the person who is from the faith of Jesus (Romans 3:25-26). Glory to God. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Origen is quoting Paul's words from Romans 3 about how God set forth Christ as an atoning sacrifice to show his righteousness.
